nrSummary.cause: Expectation mismatch — perceived build quality / sturdiness
nrSummary.notes: Customer likes the color and design of the Farmhouse Napkin Holder (FM19C0347a, 5.5"x5.5" White/Brown) but feels it is not as sturdy as expected. Mixed 3-star review with no return request. Reflects genuine perception of distressed/farmhouse-style construction — the rustic distressed finish is intentional and listing imagery shows the styled appearance.

nrSummary.cause: Off-topic / seller-conduct review — not a verified purchase
nrSummary.notes: Reviewer (Laurbar) left a 1-star review titled 'Be AWARE!' on the Taupe Ceramic Utensil Holder (HD19B235-G). Marked 'Not a verified purchase.' Review focuses on seller's marketing claims and documentation responsiveness ('I asked for documentation and none was provided') and general concerns about ceramic glazes — not actual product experience. Content fits Community Help off-topic / seller-conduct violation criteria. Community Help case drafted citing off-topic seller-conduct content, non-verified purchase (no product receipt/use), and general category commentary unrelated to actual experience with the item.

nrSummary.cause: Expectation mismatch - mouth/opening diameter
nrSummary.notes: Customer rated the Farmhouse Kitchen Utensil Holder (HD19B235-W) 3 stars. Product is fine but the narrow mouth limits what and how much can be stored. Title states 6.75 inch overall but does not disclose opening diameter. Expectation mismatch rather than defect.

nrSummary.cause: Missing feature — no non-slip bottom
nrSummary.notes: Customer (Yogo) left a 3-star review titled 'Utensil holder' on the CA listing of the White Ceramic Utensil Holder (HD19B235-W) noting absence of a no-slip bottom and pricing concern. Ceramic crock product — non-slip backing is not a current product feature. Pricing portion is off-topic but review is mixed with legitimate feature feedback. CA marketplace.

nrSummary.cause: Expectation mismatch — vague 'not how it was described'
nrSummary.notes: Customer (Madison) left a 1-star review titled 'Bad' on the CA listing of the Oh Hello Doormat (XT001-7) saying only 'Not how it was described.' Order placed April 15, 2026, reviewed April 19, 2026 — fast turnaround suggests immediate dissatisfaction at receipt. No specific complaint to address. CA marketplace.

nrSummary.cause: Filter mold complaint — charcoal filter develops mold on counter
nrSummary.notes: Customer (Lady B) left a 3-star review titled 'A Good Counter Fit' on the Mint Compost Bin (AK113-Mint), praising the color but noting that the charcoal filters 'can quickly turn to mold catchers.' Order ID not available (NA — Unable to Contact Customer). Mold on charcoal filters is a known characteristic of food-waste compost bins when used in humid kitchens.

nrSummary.cause: Product defect - print/letter fading after short outdoor use
nrSummary.notes: Customer reports the letters on the Half Moon Welcome doormat (XT006-W) faded within a week of use. Title 'Discussed' likely typo for 'Disgusted'. This is a print durability complaint on an outdoor entrance mat that faces sun, rain, and foot traffic. Listing positions the product for outdoor entrance use. No return mentioned in body.

nrSummary.cause: Expectation mismatch — size perception ('small')
nrSummary.notes: Customer (Maggie Bove Tyler) left a 3-star review titled 'Cute but…' on the Welcome Half Moon Doormat (XT006-W). Says rug is small and not as durable as others, but is keeping it for the front door and notes 'It does look nice.' Listed dimensions (30x17) are accurate in title; review reflects subjective size expectation, not a listing inaccuracy.

nrSummary.cause: Product defect — mat tore and fell apart
nrSummary.notes: Customer reports the "Hey Y'all" coir doormat (SKU DMC-YALL) completely tore and fell apart after a couple months of front-door use, despite light use (primary entry is the garage). Order placed November 18, 2025; review left May 6, 2026 — approximately 6 months of outdoor exposure. Second durability complaint logged this batch for the same SKU.

nrSummary.cause: Product defect — corner broke off
nrSummary.notes: Customer reports the whole corner of the "Hey Y'all" coir doormat (SKU DMC-YALL) broke off after barely a month of use. Order shipped March 20, 2026; review left May 2, 2026 (~6 weeks). Standard coir mat durability complaint — no evidence of misuse described. Order is within return window for follow-up.

nrSummary.cause: Germination failure — Genovese Basil
nrSummary.notes: Customer (Amazon Shopper, self-identified experienced gardener) left a 1-star review on Genovese Basil (SB-BASIL) stating seeds 'produced no basil plants' and accusing them of being 'old and repackaged.' Order placed November 16, 2025; reviewed April 26, 2026 — 5+ month customer storage gap. Legitimate germination complaint based on planting attempt; freshness accusation is opinion.

nrSummary.cause: Product defect — coir dye bleed when wet
nrSummary.notes: Customer reports the natural coir doormat (DMC-DBOR-36, 24x36 Brown) bled brown when exposed to rain, staining the doorway and adjacent sidewalk where water ran off. Discarded the mat after one week of use. This is a known characteristic of natural coir fiber and a recurring NR pattern for Barnyard Designs coir mats.

nrSummary.cause: Product defect - side handle detachment under normal lifting load
nrSummary.notes: Customer reports the handles on the outside of the Black Think Green Compost Bin (AK113-Black) come off constantly when she tries to pick it up. Order placed May 10, 2026; review on May 11, 2026 (next day). Customer is returning the unit. This is a structural defect complaint on the side handle attachment.

nrSummary.cause: Off-topic content — pricing-only complaint, no product experience cited
nrSummary.notes: Customer's review consists entirely of the sentence 'A lot to spend on a few tiny seeds.' The complaint is about price/quantity perception, not about the product's quality, viability, germination, or actual use. Peppermint seeds are naturally microscopic (this is biology, not a packaging issue) and listing imagery and bullets disclose the seed quantity. Review contains zero information about whether the customer planted, attempted to grow, or used the product.

nrSummary.cause: Expectation mismatch — sprout size vs. advertised
nrSummary.notes: Customer reports broccoli sprouts (SKU SS-BROCCO-8OZ) only grew to half the size advertised and required more work/effort than expected. Customer still ate the product and rated it 2 stars. Order placed April 4, 2026; review left May 6, 2026. Broccoli microgreen size is sensitive to harvest day, light exposure, and growing medium — common variability factor.

nrSummary.cause: Germination failure — partial (~50% rate)
nrSummary.notes: Customer (Pat V.) left a 1-star review on Organic Broccoli Sprouting Seeds 8 oz (SS-BROCCO-8OZ) reporting ~50% germination and thin stems on the sprouts that did emerge. Customer states experience growing sprouts and following instructions. Order placed March 30, 2026 — recent purchase, fresh seed expected. Legitimate complaint based on actual sprouting attempt.

nrSummary.cause: Unclear feedback — review text is incomplete or garbled
nrSummary.notes: Customer left a 3-star review on the Organic Protein Blend Sprouting Seeds (SKU SS-PROTEIN-8OZ) with a single garbled sentence: "These are my like seeds." No specific complaint, defect, or experience detail provided. Order placed April 19, 2026.

nrSummary.cause: Mold/odor during sprouting — suspected contamination
nrSummary.notes: Customer reports the Protein Blend Sprouting Seeds (SKU SS-PROTEIN-8OZ) smelled bad and developed mold by day three on both sprouting attempts. Mold during sprouting is typically caused by insufficient rinsing/drainage, high humidity, or warm ambient temperatures — not necessarily seed contamination. Hydrogen peroxide foaming on organic matter is expected (catalase reaction). Second NR on SS-PROTEIN-8OZ in this batch (Kelly Martin and Amy).

nrSummary.cause: Product quality complaint — thin material, rough-cut edges
nrSummary.notes: Customer (Amy Estrada) left a 2-star review titled 'Eeh.' stating 'Thin. Rough cut.' on the 36x24 Plain Brown polyester doormat (XT001-BLANK-36). Complaint is about poly mat material thickness and edge finishing. Legitimate product feedback based on actual purchase and use.

nrSummary.cause: Supplier packaging defect — rug rolled too tightly inside carton
nrSummary.notes: Customer reports the "Hello" doormat (SKU XT001-2-36) arrived with the letter "o" split because the rug was rolled too tight in shipping packaging. The review title "Cute but torn" affirms the product itself is desirable — the complaint is entirely about how the product was packaged and shipped. Order placed May 3, 2026; review left May 7, 2026.

nrSummary.cause: Listing inaccuracy — seed counts not matching package count claims
nrSummary.notes: Customer alleges seed counts in the 10 Herb Variety Pack (SKU SB-HERB10VAR) do not match package count claims — counted ~30 Fragrant Sage seeds vs. 50 claimed; Garden Thyme says 2,500 but appeared far less. Customer was reimbursed after emailing the company directly and updated the review to acknowledge resolution. Order placed May 3, 2026; review May 7, 2026.

nrSummary.cause: Germination/establishment failure — 'No flowers in my yard'
nrSummary.notes: Customer (P) left a 1-star review on Wildflowers for Pollinators 2 oz (SB-POLLIN-2OZ) stating no flowers came up. Order placed November 18, 2025 — likely sown spring 2026 or fall-sown. Wildflower mixes are highly sensitive to soil contact, watering, and weed competition; 'broadcast and abandon' methods commonly fail.

nrSummary.cause: Germination failure — outdoor wildflower mix
nrSummary.notes: 1-star review on Wildflowers for Pollinators seed mix, 2 oz (SB-POLLIN-2OZ). Customer reports seeds did not come up despite preparing the ground and following directions. No detail provided on planting date, USDA zone, soil conditions, or post-sow weather. Listing Bullet 5 explicitly offers a germination guarantee with replacement. Outdoor wildflower germination depends on many variables outside seed control (soil temperature at sow, consistent moisture, bird/rodent predation, late frost).

nrSummary.cause: Germination/growing failure
nrSummary.notes: Customer purchased the 10 Herb Garden Starter Kit (SKU SB-HERBGKIT) on Feb 20, 2026 and reports barely anything germinated despite following provided instructions. Common Seedboy NR pattern — herb germination success is highly sensitive to soil temperature, moisture, light, and patience (some herbs take 14–21 days). No batch defect indicators present.

nrSummary.cause: Expectation mismatch - seed blend composition
nrSummary.notes: Customer says 'This isn't the normal cat grass that stores sell. Very stiff and hard. Cats don't like it.' Product (SS-CATGRA-8OZ) is an organic blend of wheat, oat, rye, and barley which is the standard composition for cat grass. Stiffness suggests the grass was allowed to mature past the tender young blade stage that cats prefer. Customer expectation appears to be single-variety wheatgrass commonly sold at pet stores.

nrSummary.cause: Germination failure - non-rye grains (wheat, oat, barley) did not sprout
nrSummary.notes: Customer reports only rye grew from the wheat, oat, rye, and barley blend (SS-CATGRA-8OZ). This is a germination failure for three of the four seed types or a growing condition issue favoring rye (which is typically the fastest and most forgiving germinator). Order placed April 9, 2026; review on May 11, 2026.

nrSummary.cause: Germination failure — cat grass did not grow after two attempts
nrSummary.notes: 1-star review on Organic Cat Grass Seeds, 8 oz (SS-CATGRA-8OZ) — Wheat, Oat, Rye, Barley blend. Customer reports following the steps twice with no growth. No detail on growing medium, water level, light, or temperature. Seller Central shows 'Offer Courtesy Refund' button available for this review. Repeat failure across two attempts suggests possible storage or method issue on the customer end, but warrants QC attention if germination complaints cluster.

nrSummary.cause: Off-label outcome — cats refuse to eat the grass
nrSummary.notes: Customer (Lisa M) left a 1-star review on Cat Grass Seeds 16 oz (SS-CATGRA-16OZ) stating her cats won't eat the grass and that the mix appears low on oat seed (her cats' preferred variety). Title and listing describe the mix as 'Wheat, Oat, Rye, and Barley.' Cat preference is outside seller control, but blend ratio claim is verifiable.

nrSummary.cause: Product defect — mat curls/rolls at edges, will not lay flat
nrSummary.notes: Customer reports the 2-pack Premium Gray Front Door Mat (DMGR-30-S2, 17"x30") will not lay flat — edges roll up after multiple attempts to flatten. This is a known issue with rubber-backed mats shipped rolled in compact packaging; the rubber retains memory of the roll shape. 3-star rating with no return mentioned.

nrSummary.cause: Off-topic content — reviewer compares to different product category (whey) and clears product of fault
nrSummary.notes: Reviewer (vegetarian) gave 3 stars to Pea Protein 16oz but explicitly states the issue is not the product: 'Would I purchase again? Probably not, BUT it's not specifically because of this product. In my experience, whey just blends better and that's how I utilize protein powders. If you're dairy-free, I think this is a great product.' The reviewer is comparing a plant-based pea protein to a dairy-based whey protein (a different product category) and clears the product of fault — this is off-topic comparison, not a product-experience complaint.
